HTML tag names are case-insensitive: an uppercase void element must not swallow the content that follows it

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<html><head><META HTTP-EQUIV=\"Content-Type\" CONTENT=\"text/html; charset=us-ascii\"></head><body><p>Signature placeholder</p></body></html>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
